name: truebid
description: Root-level convenience scripts for running TrueBid's per-service test suites in one command. Each service is still independently buildable/testable on its own - see docs/TESTING.md.

scripts.test: for d in services/*/; do (cd "$d" && npm test) || exit 1; done && (cd frontend && npm test)
scripts.test:integration: for d in services/*/; do (cd "$d" && npm run test:integration) || exit 1; done
scripts.test:all: for d in services/*/; do (cd "$d" && npm run test:all) || exit 1; done && (cd frontend && npm test)
scripts.install:all: for d in services/*/ test/e2e/ frontend/; do (cd "$d" && npm install) || exit 1; done
